disposition_reason: Tables 3 and 4 print mean ± SD, minimum and maximum cadmium and lead (ppb) in infant formula raw materials (maltodextrin, starch, vitamin premix, raw cow's milk, whey protein, oil) and four infant formula types from a dairy plant in Shahrekord, Iran.

study.design: Plant-level survey of infant formula raw materials and finished infant formula (aflatoxin M1, lead, cadmium)
study.origin: Pegah Dairy Plant, Shahrekord, Iran (raw materials and products)
study.market: collected at the dairy plant before pasteurization
study.method: Dry ashing at 450 °C, dissolution in 0.1 M HNO3; graphite furnace AAS (Varian AA 600)
lod: Pb LOD 3, LOQ 9 ug/kg; Cd LOD 0.4, LOQ 1.2 ug/kg
study.qa: Duplicate analyses; 5-point calibration; no CRM or recovery for metals (AFM1 ELISA spike recoveries only)

findings.integrity_flag: Abstract lists maximum lead in maltodextrin and starch as 20 and 23 ppb and maximum cadmium as 5.5 and 9.5 ppb, the reverse of the Table 3 columns; the text agrees with the table means.
findings.notes: Table prints "Number of Sample 80" on every row, although 80 is the study total across all materials; per-material n is unclear. Duplicate analyses.

Aflatoxin M1 results (Table 2) are not metals and are not recorded.
